description.narrative:
I submit for your approval the following report and recommendation on a proposed grant to the Islamic Republic of Afghanistan for the Road Asset Management Project.
The proposed grant will finance priority maintenance works for part of Afghanistan's regional highway sections from Kabul to Ghazni and from Kabul to Jalalabad, which are the economic lifeline of the country's eastern region. The project will include a capacity development component to introduce sustainable road management practices, specifically in road asset management and road maintenance.

By 2022 (0541-AFG) Average travel time from Kabul to Kandahar reduced to 8 hours; Kabul to Jalalabad to 3 hours (2016 baseline: Kabul to Kandahar, 10.5 hours; Kabul to Jalalabad, 5 hours) Achievement: 13.5 Progress/Status: Deleted from the project due to cancellation. Data Source: Post-implementation report of the MOT as endorsed by the Government of Islamic Republic of Afghanistan

By 2020 (0508-0541-AFG) Number of accidents on the two project road reduced to 1,250 per year (2016 baseline: 1,760 accidents) Achievement: 1760 Progress/Status: 2 out of the 4 project parcels were cancelled by the government due to poor performances due to security threats.
Partially Achieved. Data Source: Post-implementation report of the MOT as endorsed by the Government of Islamic Republic of Afghanistan

By 2020 (0508-AFG) Average travel time from Kabul to Ghazni Road reduced to 2.2 hours (2016 baseline: 2.5 hours) Achievement: 2.4 Progress/Status: 1. Civil works for periodic maintenance of the Kabul-Jalalabad Highway for two civil works contracts completed for a total of 88.8 km; namely, (i) 53.8 km between KM86+KM294 up to KM140+KM094), and (ii) 35 km between KM51+KM294 up to KM86+KM294).
2. Section 1 - civil works for periodic maintenance of the Kabul-Ghazni for 34km suspended due to security issues. Physical progress at 4%. ADB endorsed the Government's proposal to terminate the contract. Submisison of formal agreement between MPW and the contractor awaited.
3. Section 2 - civil works for periodic maintenance of Kabul-Jalalabad Highway from KM86 up to 140KM for 40km has no progress. ADB endorsed the Government's proposal to terminate the contract. Submisison of formal agreement between MPW and the contractor awaited. Data Source: Post-implementation report of the MOT as endorsed by the Government of Islamic Republic of Afghanistan

By 2022 (0541-AFG) Improve pavement condition to IRI 4-5 (2015 baseline: IRI 8-12) Achievement: 10 Progress/Status: Deleted from the project due to cancellation. Data Source: Post-implementation report of the MOT as endorsed by the Government of Islamic Republic of Afghanistan Baseline value: IRI 8-12
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: National highways in the southeastern region maintained Indicator: By 2020 (0508-AFG) Periodic maintenance of approximately 220 km of national highways completed by 2020 Achievement: 88 Progress/Status: Civil works for periodic maintenance of the Kabul-Jalalabad Highway 88 km completed. The rest of the packages are being deffered because the MPW intends to descope these works. ADB issued no objection to cancellation of 2 sections on 3 March 2020. Data Source: MPW monitoring and completion reports
